sources.entry: Archify by tt-a1i - An Agent Skill for Claude Code that generates interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML. Typed JSON, local renderers, and delivery checks support source-linked node details, path tracing, themes, and export.

summary.one_liner: Archify is an Agent Skill for Claude Code and similar coding agents that turns descriptions or repositories into interactive, self-contained HTML diagrams.
summary.what_it_does: Given a text description or a request to read a repository, the agent produces typed JSON that Archify validates and renders into a standalone HTML file. Supported diagram types include architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle, ERD, class, tree, timeline, and waterfall. The viewer offers node details, focus and upstream/downstream reach tracing, route probing, themes, and export to PNG, WebP, JPG, or PDF. A CLI provides validate, preview, deliver, and compare commands, and an optional mode can pin source links to a Git commit. The README also describes one-page explainer answers that combine panels, tables, and diagrams.
use_cases: Diagram a system architecture from a description or repository
Map a CI/CD or approval workflow
Visualize an API request and cache-miss path
Document a database schema as an ERD
Build an interactive explainer page for a technical question
Compare before and after architecture for design review
stack: Agent Skill (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, OpenCode)
notable: Typed JSON intermediate representation with schema validation before delivery
Atomic delivery: a new HTML file replaces the previous output only after all checks pass
Interactive viewer with focus, upstream/downstream reach, and route tracing
Optional source-linked architecture nodes pinned to a public Git commit
Zero-dependency CLI with a loopback-only live preview mode
caveats: Automatic Mermaid parsing, general auto-layout, hosted sharing, and WYSIWYG editing are explicitly out of scope
Update checks make a GET request to a fixed manifest unless ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1 is set
Some install surfaces (e.g. Claude.ai) depend on Node.js access in the sandbox; third-party integrations are community-maintained
